en: A vintage illustrated postcard showing a seaside town with buildings on a hill, a sandy beach, and several large wooden bathhouses or piers extending into the sea. There are handwritten notes in Cyrillic script on the right and bottom. The words 'SOUVENIR de VARNA.' and 'ПОЗДРАВЪ ОТЪ ВАРНА' (Greetings from Varna) are printed, as well as 'LES BAINS DE MER' (The Sea Baths) and 'МОРСКИТѢ БАНИ'.
